name: bluebeam
description: Work with Bluebeam Studio (Projects, Sessions, files, markups, PDF jobs, webhooks) from Claude Code via the official Bluebeam Studio REST API with OAuth 2.0. Includes a zero-dependency MCP server, a `bb` CLI, a guided /bluebeam:setup, and the full endpoint reference.

client_id.title: Bluebeam Client ID
client_id.description: From developers.bluebeam.com > My Apps > your app. Optional here: you can also run /bluebeam:setup or `bb config set`.

client_secret.title: Bluebeam Client Secret
client_secret.description: From the same My Apps page. Stored in secure storage.

region.title: Bluebeam API region
region.description: Must match the Region your app was created in.

redirect_uri.title: OAuth redirect URI
redirect_uri.description: Must be listed on your app in the Developer Portal.
